_doc: Reference numbers reported in the submission's main section (Table tab:hero, Table tab:scale, Table tab:diag-main, Table tab:logvol-main). Each cell key is the dataset; each method key is the publication-facing name (GNF, GNF+ACI, KalmanFCP, StaticCGIF, DiagGRU, GCNrankzero, FactorCGIF, AgACIGroupCGIF, ACIPerGroupFactorCGIF, EWMACovCGIF, RollingCovCGIF, CopulaCPTS, MultiDimSPCI). Each value is `[mean, std]` for the per-coord ellipsoid width at alpha=0.10. The runner emits a delta column comparing your reproduction to these numbers; deltas inside `2 * std` are within Monte-Carlo tolerance.

table_logvol_main._doc: Per-coord normalised log-volume \Vhat_m on the headline cells (lower is sharper).  10-seed mean.

table_diag_main._doc: Range of empirical contraction-rate diagnostics across the audited real cells (Table tab:diag-main).
